About the Role  
We are looking for a firmware engineer who understands radios as well as code. You will build firmware for long-range, low-power wireless devices and test tools, from radio drivers and protocol stacks to key storage, over-the-air updates and field validation. You will think in link budgets, timing and security, not just in registers.  
  
You will work directly with the Principal Architect on connected products where reliability in the field, power efficiency and security matter as much as features.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Radio and Protocol Firmware**

* Develop and maintain **LoRa and LoRaWAN** protocol stacks (1.0.x and 1.1): activation, device classes, receive windows, MAC commands, adaptive data rate and regional parameters.
* Apply **spread-spectrum and frequency-hopping radio concepts**, and bring up new radio chipsets and modes behind a clean driver interface.
* Implement robust **retry, acknowledgement and duplicate-handling strategies** for lossy and high-latency links.

#### **Link and RF Engineering**

* Perform **link-budget analysis** and interpret sensitivity, interference and range-test data.
* Account for **frequency stability and timing** (crystal and TCXO choice, drift, offset handling) in radio design and firmware.
* Run **field range and reliability trials**, and turn the results into firmware and configuration improvements.

#### **Security and Key Management**

* Implement AES-128 and AES-CMAC correctly, and manage keys in **protected storage or a secure element**.
* Design **secure device activation and key lifecycle**: provisioning, rotation, revocation, and safe persistence of counters across resets.
* Build **signed over-the-air updates** with a secure boot chain.

#### **Drivers, Gateways and Test**

* Write **SPI radio drivers** and work with gateway-side software (concentrator HALs, packet forwarders and bridges) and timing sources.
* Build **test infrastructure**: Python simulators, hardware-in-the-loop automation, power profiling and instrument-based RF validation.

### **Required Qualifications**

#### **Education:**

* BE/B.Tech/M.Tech in Electronics, Communications, Embedded Systems or a related field.

#### **Experience:**

* **4–5+ years** of embedded C/C++ on ARM Cortex-M with an RTOS.
* Hands-on wireless protocol work (LoRa/LoRaWAN or a similar low-power wide-area technology), including field debugging.

### **Technical Skills Required**

#### **Embedded Core**

* FreeRTOS or Zephyr, interrupt-driven design, low-power design with measured sleep currents.

#### **Radio and Protocols**

* LoRa PHY parameters (spreading factor, bandwidth, coding rate), LoRaWAN MAC internals, modulation fundamentals, sensitivity and link-budget reasoning.

#### **Security**

* AES-CMAC and AES-CTR, key storage, secure boot, safe counter handling.

#### **Instruments and Tools**

* Spectrum analyser, power profiler, protocol sniffers, logic analyser, JTAG/SWD.

#### **Software Tooling**

* Python, Git and CI.

### **Preferred (Bonus) Skills**

* SDR capture and analysis (IQ recordings, GNU Radio) and DSP fundamentals.
* GNSS and precise timing, or FPGA basics.
* Embedded Rust, and RF certification experience (WPC, ETSI, FCC).

At **EURTH TECHTRONICS PVT LTD**, we design and deliver connected electronics from idea to deployment. Work on the radio-to-cloud path of real long-range IoT products, with test equipment and field trials, not just simulation. You will see your firmware tested against physics.

We are looking for a hands-on Embedded Linux engineer to build lean, secure, field-updatable Linux images for ARM-based edge computers, including SoC-plus-FPGA and industrial boards. You will own the path from bootloader to root filesystem, so that images are small, survive power loss, update safely and rebuild reproducibly, even without internet access.  
  
You will work directly with the Principal Architect on long-lifecycle, high-reliability products where memory is tight and every dependency must justify itself.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Platform and Image Engineering**

* Own **Yocto/OpenEmbedded layers** (distro, machine and image recipes) and the build flow (kas or repo).
* Produce **minimal images** (musl/BusyBox or systemd) within strict size, RAM and boot-time budgets, along with a developer SDK.
* Run **offline, reproducible builds** with source and sstate mirrors, vendored dependencies and pinned versions.
* Generate **SBOMs and licence reports**, and enforce licence policy at build time.
* Evaluate OpenWrt or Buildroot where they are the better fit.

#### **Bootloader, Kernel and Drivers**

* Customise **U-Boot** (SPL, FIT images, environment, A/B slot logic) and the **Linux kernel** (minimal configuration, device tree and overlays).
* Write and debug drivers for SPI, UART, I2C, USB, Ethernet, watchdog, RTC, GPIO and pin control.
* Bring up **SoC-plus-FPGA platforms**: programmable-logic device trees, and real-time cores with remoteproc and OpenAMP.
* Tune latency and real-time behaviour, including PREEMPT\_RT where needed.

#### **Update, Security and Resilience**

* Implement **A/B updates with automatic rollback** (RAUC, SWUpdate or Mender) and a **read-only root with overlay**.
* Build a **secure boot chain**: signed images, dm-verity, key handling, and TPM or TrustZone/OP-TEE integration.
* Design **power-fail-safe storage** (ext4, F2FS, UBIFS, SQLite durability) and watchdog and health strategies.
* Design for bit errors and wear: error-correction awareness, integrity checks and recovery.

#### **Quality, Performance and CI**

* Profile boot time and memory (perf, ftrace, bootchart, smem) and add **image-size regression checks**.
* Build CI for images with QEMU and hardware-in-the-loop tests, and write clear runbooks.

### **Required Qualifications**

#### **Education:**

* BE/B.Tech/M.Tech in Electronics, Embedded Systems, Computer Science or a related field.

#### **Experience:**

* **4–5+ years** in embedded Linux, with at least one product shipped on a Yocto-based or similar custom image.
* Hands-on bootloader and kernel work on ARM platforms.

### **Technical Skills Required**

#### **Yocto and Build Systems**

* Layers, bbappend, devtool, SDK generation, sstate and download mirrors, SPDX and licence controls.

#### **Bootloaders and Kernel**

* U-Boot, FIT images and secure boot, device tree, kernel configuration and debugging.

#### **Storage, Update and Security**

* squashfs and overlayfs, dm-verity, RAUC/SWUpdate/Mender, hardened userland.

#### **Hardware and Debug**

* JTAG/SWD, serial consoles, logic analyser, oscilloscope, crash-dump analysis.

#### **Languages and Tooling**

* Strong C, shell and Python; Git and CI; cross-compilation for aarch64 and armv7.

### **Preferred (Bonus) Skills**

* Zynq-class SoC-plus-FPGA work with vendor tooling.
* High-reliability design experience (fault containment, integrity checks, error correction).
* Rust, and familiarity with open-source licences (MIT, Apache, GPL, AGPL).

### **Why Join Us**

At **EURTH TECHTRONICS PVT LTD**, we design and deliver connected electronics from idea to deployment. Build the foundation that real devices boot from. You will work on long-lifecycle products where size, security and recoverability matter, with direct access to a senior architect and real hardware.

Candidates without hands-on Kubernetes, VM and Linux experience will not be considered.

**Kubernetes**

Use kubectl to get, describe and read logs for pods, deployments, services and nodes; read cluster events; spot why a pod is failing; restart or scale a workload under a runbook; know namespaces, ConfigMaps and Secrets

**Virtual machines**

Check VM state, start, stop and reboot, reach the console or SSH, and diagnose network, disk and resource problems on VMware, KVM or cloud VMs (AWS, Azure or GCP)

Work fluently in the shell: ls, cd, cat, grep, awk, sed, tail, find, ps, top, df, du, free, ss or netstat, systemctl, journalctl, chmod, chown, ssh, curl, ping, dig, traceroute

Work a queue in Zendesk or a similar tool, write clear updates, and handle live customer calls calmly

Fluent spoken and written English

* Monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana or Datadog

* ITIL foundation and incident-management experience
* Exposure to AI or GPU workloads

**Education:** Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

The support desk runs 24/7, covered by a team of eight. Each engineer works one shift at a time (about 9 hours, 5 days a week) on a rotation, with rotational weekly offs. title: Senior Manager Quality Engineering
description:
**Role:**
Senior Manager, Quality Engineering

**Function:**
Quality Engineering / Software Testing

**Location:**
Gurugram or Kolkata

**Type:**
Full-time

**Industry:**
AI, Medical SaaS, Dental Technology

**About Company**

The company builds AI-powered SaaS for the U.S. dental market.

Its platform unifies analytics, communications, scheduling, payments, and marketing automation. Thousands of solo practices, group practices, and DSOs rely on it daily.

It is a profitable SaaS business approaching eight figures in revenue. The company is mission-driven and execution-oriented — quality is designed in, not inspected in at the end.

If you want to build in a large, under-digitized healthcare vertical and see clear, measurable impact, this is the place.

**Position Overview**

This role leads a team of 6–10 Quality Engineers and owns the modernization of how quality is built into the company's products. The mandate is to increase release confidence faster than QA headcount grows — through automation engineering, AI-assisted workflows, production observability, and shared quality ownership across Engineering, Product, and DevOps. This is a hands-on technical leadership position: the person in this role personally writes and reviews automation code, designs testing architecture, and investigates difficult production issues.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Establish a modern quality-engineering operating model based on shared ownership across Engineering, Product, DevOps, and Quality Engineering; define risk-based testing strategies for critical customer workflows, integrations, and platforms.
* Own the architecture and evolution of web, API, integration, and end-to-end automation — personally build and maintain production-quality code in Playwright and TypeScript, including reusable libraries, fixtures, test-data systems, and parallel execution infrastructure.
* Integrate high-signal suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent); treat flaky and noisy tests as engineering defects and continuously improve execution speed, stability, and diagnosability.
* Define testing and evaluation strategies for AI assistants, call intelligence, and automated conversation workflows — build repeatable evaluations covering accuracy, hallucination risk, context retention, fallback logic, unsafe output, privacy, and latency.
* Use AI coding assistants and agents in daily engineering workflows across test design, automation development, code review, debugging, and incident analysis; establish practical AI-assisted workflows for the team and measure their impact on development time, maintenance effort, and release-validation speed.
* Investigate production and pre-production issues using SQL, logs, traces, API requests, browser developer tools, and monitoring platforms; lead root-cause analyses that address the architectural, testing, or observability gap that allowed a defect to escape.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of 6–10 Quality Engineers through clear goals, direct feedback, performance reviews, hiring, and career growth — raising the technical bar while scaling quality through better systems rather than linear headcount.

**Must Have Criteria**

* 8+ years in software quality, test automation, or quality engineering, including 3+ years of people leadership managing and developing engineers.
* 4+ years of hands-on automation experience; personally written, reviewed, debugged, and maintained production automation code within the last 12 months.
* Strong software engineering ability in TypeScript or JavaScript; experience designing automation systems from the ground up, not only scripting within an existing framework.
* Strong experience with Playwright for browser automation and API testing; candidates from Selenium or Cypress must demonstrate current coding ability and a track record of modernizing legacy automation architecture.
* Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent) and improving execution reliability, speed, and diagnosability.

* Experience testing AI assistants, LLM-powered products, conversational systems, call intelligence, or automated communication workflows.
* Background in healthcare SaaS, dental technology, VoIP, payments, or other business-critical platforms.
* Experience with mobile automation, distributed architectures, third-party integrations, and asynchronous processing.
* Exposure to performance, reliability, security, privacy, accessibility, or observability testing.

Job Summary 
 We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to take technical ownership of the design, development and productionisation of AI and machine-learning capabilities within a B2B procurement product. This is a hands-on role for someone who can move confidently from ambiguous business problems and imperfect data to reliable, measurable AI solutions. You will lead the development of models and intelligent workflows across use cases such as supplier scoring, spend analytics, anomaly detection, forecasting, recommendations and document intelligence. You will work across the full lifecycle: problem definition, data preparation, modelling, evaluation, deployment, monitoring and ongoing improvement. As a senior member of the team, you will set technical direction, raise engineering standards and mentor other engineers. You will be expected to make sound trade-offs between accuracy, explainability, latency, cost and maintainability, ensuring that AI features create meaningful value for enterprise users. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own the end-to-end architecture and delivery of production-grade AI and machine-learning solutions for procurement and spend-management workflows. Partner with product, domain and engineering stakeholders to translate business problems into well-defined AI use cases, measurable objectives and pragmatic delivery plans. Design, develop and optimise models for supplier scoring, classification, anomaly detection, forecasting, recommendations and document intelligence. Build robust data-preparation and feature-engineering pipelines for structured, semi-structured and document-based data. Develop and evaluate predictive models using appropriate statistical and machine-learning approaches, including baseline definition, validation strategy and error analysis. Lead the use of LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agentic AI workflows where they are suitable, safe and commercially valuable. Design reliable document-intelligence workflows involving OCR, information extraction, classification, validation and human-in-the-loop review. Establish model evaluation, experiment-tracking and versioning practices to ensure repeatable, auditable development. Deploy models and inference services that meet product expectations for performance, reliability, security and scalability. Define and implement model monitoring for quality, drift, latency, cost and operational health; lead retraining and improvement initiatives when required. Work with backend and platform engineers to integrate AI capabilities into product APIs, workflows and user experiences. Review code, technical designs and model choices; establish high standards for testing, documentation, reproducibility and production readiness. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team capability through knowledge sharing, pairing and constructive technical feedback. Stay current with relevant advances in machine learning, LLM applications and MLOps, applying new approaches selectively and responsibly. 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Mandatory Requirements 
 5+ years of professional experience in AI, machine learning, data science or a closely related engineering role, including experience delivering production systems. Strong proficiency in Python and practical experience with the core data and machine-learning ecosystem, including pandas, NumPy and scikit-learn. Strong experience designing, training, tuning and evaluating machine-learning models, including cross-validation, hyperparameter optimisation and error analysis. Demonstrated experience with tree-based and gradient-boosting models such as XGBoost, LightGBM or equivalent approaches. Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience working with complex, imperfect and high-volume business data. Proven expertise in data cleaning, validation, feature engineering and building repeatable data-processing pipelines. Experience delivering one or more of the following in production: anomaly detection, forecasting, recommendation systems, classification or document intelligence. Practical experience with LLM-based applications, including prompt design, RAG patterns, tool/function calling or agentic workflows. Experience deploying and maintaining model inference services or AI-enabled APIs in collaboration with software engineering teams. Strong understanding of model performance, explainability, bias, data leakage, model drift and the trade-offs involved in production AI systems. Experience with experiment tracking, model versioning, reproducibility and monitoring practices. Strong software-engineering fundamentals, including API integration, testing, code review, Git and maintainable production code. Ability to independently lead technical discussions and communicate complex AI concepts clearly to product, engineering and non-technical stakeholders. 
 
 Good To Have 
 Experience with deep-learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or Keras. Experience with NLP, OCR, information extraction and document-processing pipelines. Experience with time-series forecasting libraries and methods, such as statsmodels, Prophet or equivalent. Familiarity with LangChain, LlamaIndex or similar frameworks for LLM application development. Experience with MLOps platforms, model serving, feature stores, workflow orchestration or CI/CD for machine-learning systems. Experience deploying on AWS, GCP or Azure. Exposure to procurement, supply-chain, finance, enterprise SaaS or other data-rich B2B product domains. 
 
 What We Care About 
 Building AI capabilities that solve real user and business problems rather than pursuing novelty for its own sake. Sound engineering judgement: choosing the simplest reliable solution that delivers measurable value. Ownership from discovery through production operation, not only model development. Rigour around data quality, evaluation, security, explainability and responsible AI use. Clear, direct communication and productive collaboration across technical and non-technical teams.
